title: Report: Jaguars plan for Travis Hunter to be a full-time corner

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Jaguars plan for Travis Hunter to be a full-time corner
sources.description: Jaguars General Manager James Gladstone updated Travis Hunter's knee rehab this week and said that the second overall pick in the 2025 draft will be limited in the offseason with the expectation that he'll be fully cleared for training camp.
